items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: They had, uh, what's the other brother name? I can't call his name, but died. I don't know. They had, uh, a drummer who used to play with Buddy P.T. He's a Joseph. I don't know. He's a wonderful drummer. I can't remember. I can't call Buddy P.T.

ctx.x: And did you play a uke too?

Yeah, I started with a musician. I started with, with, with, with, with, with, with, uh, Voinel Joseph. That's the last drummer Clayvon William had. He had a brother who was for drumming, named Alton Joseph, but he played ukulele too. And, uh, what's the other brother name? I can't call his name, but died. I don't know. They had, they had a drummer who used to play with Buddy P.T. He's a Joseph. I don't know. He's a wonderful drummer. I can't remember. I can't call Buddy P.T. But he went blind. You never heard of…
Yeah. But when you played the ukulele there, did people give you money or?
